newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of England bought Canadian dollars - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of England bought Canadian dollars - traders.

text.p: The Bank of England intervened and bought Canadian dollars for U.S. on behalf of the Bank of Canada early on Thursday during European trading hours, traders said.
They said the Bank began supporting the Canadian dollar after it weakened past C$1.4005 (US$0.7140) and continued buying until the unit hit its lowest level in two years at C$1.4018 (US$0.7133).
After the intervention, the Canadian dollar recovered to open around C$1.3985 (US$0.7150) in North American trading today after Wednesday's close of C$1.3974 (US$0.7156).
The Bank of Canada does not comment on intervention.
